data.gender_notes: AlDattar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, AlDattar means 'The Giver'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'dattara' which means 'to give'. It is a name of honor and respect, suitable for a son who will grow up to be a generous and giving person. The name AlDattar carries the meaning “The Giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlDattar usually hope their child will grow to embody the giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with blessings and generosity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlDattar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
